privacyIntro: Protection of your data is very important to us! Here we explain simply and clearly how we handle information.
privacyStorageText:
We only store:
- Your player name (nickname is enough!)
- Your scores

These data are stored exclusively in the local storage of your own browser. They never leave your computer or device.
privacyNameCheckText:
When you enter your name, we check it briefly for inappropriate content. For this, your name is sent once to the Google Gemini API to ensure safety.
We do not store your name on a server. Google uses the input only for this check.
privacyTrackingText:
We use:
- No cookies
- No web analytics
- No advertising
- No social media plugins
We do not track users.
privacyChildText: This app is made for kids. There are no external links, no chat, and no data sharing.
privacyLegalText:
Switzerland – revDSG: Data is processed transparently and minimally.
EU – GDPR Art. 6(1)(f): Legitimate interest in child safety.
